scope: Two independent local app browser profiles; controlled website in actual Windows AppContainer shared browser; not hosted acceptance.
checks: Independent participant sees no owner login screen before explicit sharing.
Actual dedicated browser frame appears inside Artifacts; no iframe or desktop capture.
Owner explicitly enables the granted teammate’s authenticated viewport.
Explicit handoff advances authority; real pointer input comes only from the active controller.
Viewer selection remains participant-local and does not cancel the session.
Pause closes the isolated cookie profile and does not repeat inference or input.
Explicit owner resume creates a fresh private browser and never replays prior commands.
Canvas/Workflow layout and physical usage remain unchanged; no model calls.
Browser viewer controls fit a 390-pixel viewport.
